title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: The Hague-Visby Limit per Package and per Kilogram
content:
The Hague-Visby limit is the statutory ceiling on the line's liability for a loss wherever a tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` measures liability by Hague-Visby limitation.

## Definition

Two amounts in Special Drawing Rights (SDR) are compared:

- the per-package limit multiplied by the number of affected packages; and
- the per-kilogram limit multiplied by the affected weight in kilograms.

The Hague-Visby limit is the higher of the two, converted into US dollars at the SDR rate of the line's claims tariff, and rounded to the cent. Where a tier uses this yardstick, the settlement equals the proven loss up to this limit and never beyond it.

## Limits by tier

| Tier | Limit per package or unit (SDR) | Limit per kilogram of gross weight (SDR) |
|---|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 666.67 | 2.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 666.67 | 2.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 666.67 | 2.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 666.67 | 2.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 666.67 | 2.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 666.67 | 2.00 |

## Worked examples in SDR (hypothetical losses)

| Affected packages | Affected weight (kg) | Package amount (SDR) | Weight amount (SDR) | Higher amount (SDR) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 3400.0 | 8000.04 | 6800.00 | 8000.04, from the package limit |
| 2 | 1500.0 | 1333.34 | 3000.00 | 3000.00, from the weight limit |

In each row the higher amount is then converted into US dollars at the claims tariff rate, and the dollar figure is rounded to the cent to give the Hague-Visby limit.
